capture_basis: Legacy manual invocation environment for a plain (uniform-opponent, non-ladder) throughput run of multirun_pilot_v1, as used by the 2026-07-23/24 operating-point and fair-campaign runs: the eight value knobs plus the CUDA placement trio, with every mode knob unset. Captured under the clean-environment precondition: every name in the launcher's full whitelist was unset before capture, so absent-in-legacy means genuinely unset, not inherited. Names outside common.ps1's 20-name EnvironmentNames list were never managed by any legacy launcher; gate A2 (not this fixture) proves the new launcher clears them.
